output.notes: Ticket 103 requests 20 units of CC-HOOD-NAVY, size M. Current stock is 8, a shortfall of 12. Other sizes in stock: S 4, L 14, XL 6 (these do not satisfy the requested M size). Unit cost is $22.00 and list price is $58.00, giving $36.00 per-unit margin at list price. A discount of up to $36.00 per unit (lowest price $22.00) is mathematically possible without making unit margin negative; at exactly $22.00 margin is zero. No inventory or pricing was changed.

output.summary: Yale AI Club requests 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M with a bulk discount. Inventory has 8 size M available, leaving 12 unfilled. Unit cost is $22, list price is $58, and list-price margin is $36 per unit.
output.recommendation: Do not promise immediate fulfillment of all 20 or close the ticket yet. Tell the customer that only 8 size M hoodies are currently available and confirm whether they would accept a partial order or wait for replenishment; replenishment timing/vendor details were not established. If offering a discount, keep the price at or above $22 per hoodie to avoid a negative per-unit margin (at $22 the margin is zero). Any final offer and fulfillment plan need human handling; no money movement is involved in this recommendation.
